scenario.topic: Choose the cover design for the self-published novel

options.name: Mystical Forest Illustration
options.upside: Creates an immersive fantasy atmosphere with intricate details.
options.concern: May appear too complex for quick recognition on small thumbnails.

options.name: Minimalist Symbolic Design
options.upside: Simple and clean, easy to recognize at a glance.
options.concern: Might not convey the fantasy theme clearly to some readers.

options.name: Character Portrait Cover
options.upside: Connects readers emotionally by highlighting the protagonist.
options.concern: Could limit appeal if readers prefer broader fantasy elements.

options.name: Abstract Magical Elements

attrs.target_audience_appeal: fans of mystical and magical themes

options.upside: Visually striking with vibrant colors and dynamic composition.
options.concern: Abstract nature may confuse readers about the novel’s genre.

shared_context: The group is selecting a cover design for a self-published novel. Each design varies in style, color scheme, and illustration type, aiming to attract the target audience of young adult fantasy readers.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a 27-year-old avid reader who loves character-driven fantasy novels.
personas.private_goal: To choose a cover that emotionally connects with readers through the protagonist.

A.reason_for: Creates an immersive fantasy atmosphere that complements the story's world.
A.reason_against: May be too complex for quick recognition, which could reduce visibility.

B.reason_for: Simple and clean design is visually appealing.
B.reason_against: Does not highlight characters or emotional connection, which is important to me.

C.reason_for: Connects readers emotionally by focusing on the main character, matching my preference for character-driven stories.

D.reason_for: Visually striking and vibrant, which could attract attention.
D.reason_against: Abstract nature might confuse readers about the story’s focus.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a 34-year-old graphic designer who appreciates modern and minimalist aesthetics.
personas.private_goal: To select a cover that is instantly recognizable and stands out in thumbnail views.

A.reason_for: Detailed landscape appeals to fantasy enthusiasts and creates atmosphere.
A.reason_against: Too complex for small thumbnails, which reduces quick recognition.

B.reason_for: Simple, clean, and easy to recognize at a glance, perfect for digital thumbnails.

C.reason_for: Warm tones and character focus could engage readers emotionally.
C.reason_against: Limits appeal to character-driven stories and may not stand out visually.

D.reason_for: Bright colors and dynamic composition are eye-catching and modern.
D.reason_against: Abstract elements might confuse some readers about the genre.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a 22-year-old fantasy fan who enjoys mystical and magical themes in art.
personas.private_goal: To pick a cover that visually captures the magical essence of the novel and attracts fans of mystical fantasy.

A.reason_for: Immersive and detailed forest scene fits well with mystical fantasy themes.
A.reason_against: Could be too intricate for quick recognition on small screens.

B.reason_for: Minimalist design is clean and modern.
B.reason_against: Does not clearly communicate the magical fantasy theme, which is important to me.

C.reason_for: Warm character portrait can create emotional connection.
C.reason_against: May not fully capture the broader magical and mystical elements I prefer.

D.reason_for: Bright blues and golds with floating magical symbols perfectly capture the mystical and magical essence I want.

acceptance_reasons.D: Bright colors and dynamic composition are eye-catching and modern.
